meanings.en: the act of controlling or suppressing something by force
meanings.exampleEn: The government used repression to silence its critics.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet eleştirmenlerini susturmak için baskı kullandı.

meanings.en: a new printing of a book or document
meanings.exampleEn: This reprint of the novel includes a new introduction.
meanings.exampleTr: Romanın bu yeni baskısı yeni bir önsöz içeriyor.

meanings.en: to criticize or correct someone, usually gently
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher reproved the student for being late.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen geç kaldığı için öğrenciyi azarladı.

meanings.en: the place where someone lives
meanings.exampleEn: The ambassador's residence is in the city center.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyükelçinin konutu şehir merkezindedir.

meanings.en: the act of formally leaving a job or position
meanings.exampleEn: The minister announced his resignation yesterday.
meanings.exampleTr: Bakan dün istifasını açıkladı.

meanings.en: the act of opposing or fighting against something
meanings.exampleEn: There was strong resistance to the new tax law.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni vergi yasasına karşı güçlü bir direniş vardı.

meanings.en: a firm decision or the solving of a problem
meanings.exampleEn: Her New Year's resolution was to exercise more.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yıl kararı daha çok egzersiz yapmaktı.

meanings.en: deep, clear, and continuing to sound
meanings.exampleEn: He had a deep, resonant voice that filled the hall.
meanings.exampleTr: Salonu dolduran derin, tınlayan bir sesi vardı.

meanings.en: in a way that is considered socially acceptable or decent
meanings.exampleEn: She was always respectably dressed for work.
meanings.exampleTr: İş için her zaman düzgünce giyinirdi.

meanings.en: admired and regarded highly by others
meanings.exampleEn: He is a respected scientist in his field.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendi alanında saygın bir bilim insanıdır.

meanings.en: the process of breathing
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor measured the patient's rate of respiration.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor hastanın solunum hızını ölçtü.

meanings.en: relating to breathing or the organs of breathing
meanings.exampleEn: Smoking can cause serious respiratory diseases.
meanings.exampleTr: Sigara içmek ciddi solunum hastalıklarına neden olabilir.

meanings.en: a rule or limit that controls what is allowed
meanings.exampleEn: There are restrictions on parking in the city center.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehir merkezinde park etmeye dair kısıtlamalar var.

meanings.en: to begin again after a pause
meanings.exampleEn: They will resume the meeting after lunch.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğle yemeğinden sonra toplantıya yeniden başlayacaklar.

meanings.en: a person or business that sells goods to the public
meanings.exampleEn: The retailer offered a discount on all winter clothing.
meanings.exampleTr: Perakendeci tüm kışlık giysilerde indirim sundu.

meanings.en: to slow down or delay the progress of something
meanings.exampleEn: Cold weather can retard the growth of plants.
meanings.exampleTr: Soğuk hava bitkilerin büyümesini yavaşlatabilir.

meanings.en: the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye
meanings.exampleEn: The image is focused onto the retina at the back of the eye.
meanings.exampleTr: Görüntü, gözün arkasındaki retinaya odaklanır.

meanings.en: the period of life after one stops working
meanings.exampleEn: He is looking forward to a peaceful retirement.
meanings.exampleTr: Huzurlu bir emeklilik dönemini dört gözle bekliyor.

meanings.en: the act of withdrawing, or a quiet place for rest
meanings.exampleEn: The army was forced into a hasty retreat.
meanings.exampleTr: Ordu aceleyle geri çekilmeye zorlandı.

meanings.en: to get something back or recover it
meanings.exampleEn: She retrieved her keys from under the sofa.
meanings.exampleTr: Anahtarlarını kanepenin altından geri aldı.

meanings.en: a surprising fact that is made known
meanings.exampleEn: The revelation about the company shocked investors.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket hakkındaki ifşa yatırımcıları şok etti.

meanings.en: the act of hurting someone in return for a wrong
meanings.exampleEn: He swore to take revenge on his enemies.
meanings.exampleTr: Düşmanlarından intikam almaya yemin etti.

meanings.en: deep respect and admiration
meanings.exampleEn: They spoke of their teacher with great reverence.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmenlerinden büyük bir saygıyla söz ettiler.

meanings.en: to change something to the opposite or move backward
meanings.exampleEn: The court decided to reverse the earlier decision.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme önceki kararı tersine çevirmeye karar verdi.

meanings.en: the act of becoming active or popular again
meanings.exampleEn: There has been a revival of interest in folk music.
meanings.exampleTr: Halk müziğine olan ilginin yeniden canlanması yaşandı.

meanings.en: to bring back to life, strength, or activity
meanings.exampleEn: The paramedics managed to revive the patient.
meanings.exampleTr: Sağlık görevlileri hastayı ayıltmayı başardı.

meanings.exampleEn: The French Revolution changed the country forever.
meanings.exampleTr: Fransız Devrimi ülkeyi sonsuza dek değiştirdi.

meanings.en: involving a complete or dramatic change
meanings.exampleEn: The new technology was truly revolutionary.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni teknoloji gerçekten çığır açıcıydı.

meanings.en: to change something completely and dramatically
meanings.exampleEn: The internet revolutionized the way we communicate.
meanings.exampleTr: İnternet, iletişim kurma şeklimizde devrim yarattı.

meanings.en: to move in a circle around a central point
meanings.exampleEn: The planets revolve around the sun.
meanings.exampleTr: Gezegenler güneşin etrafında döner.

meanings.en: a large thick-skinned animal with one or two horns on its nose
meanings.exampleEn: The rhinoceros is an endangered species in Africa.
meanings.exampleTr: Gergedan Afrika'da nesli tükenmekte olan bir türdür.

meanings.en: to have words with the same ending sounds
meanings.exampleEn: The word 'cat' rhymes with the word 'hat'.
meanings.exampleTr: 'Cat' kelimesi 'hat' kelimesiyle kafiyelidir.

meanings.en: having a regular pattern of sounds or movements
meanings.exampleEn: The rhythmic sound of the waves helped her relax.
meanings.exampleTr: Dalgaların ritmik sesi onun rahatlamasına yardımcı oldu.

meanings.en: one of the curved bones around the chest
meanings.exampleEn: He broke a rib when he fell off his bike.
meanings.exampleTr: Bisikletinden düşünce bir kaburgasını kırdı.

meanings.en: a clever question or puzzle that is hard to answer
meanings.exampleEn: The children tried to solve the difficult riddle.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar zor bilmeceyi çözmeye çalıştı.

meanings.en: a person who rides a horse, bicycle, or motorcycle
meanings.exampleEn: The rider guided the horse over the fence.
meanings.exampleTr: Binici atı çitin üzerinden geçirdi.

meanings.en: a long narrow raised part of a surface, especially of land
meanings.exampleEn: They hiked along the mountain ridge at sunset.
meanings.exampleTr: Gün batımında dağ sırtı boyunca yürüdüler.

meanings.en: the quality of being morally right or good
meanings.exampleEn: He was admired for his honesty and righteousness.
meanings.exampleTr: Dürüstlüğü ve doğruluğu için takdir ediliyordu.

meanings.en: correctly or with good reason
meanings.exampleEn: She was rightly proud of her achievements.
meanings.exampleTr: Başarılarıyla haklı olarak gurur duyuyordu.

meanings.en: the outer edge of a round object
meanings.exampleEn: She wiped the rim of the glass before drinking.
meanings.exampleTr: İçmeden önce bardağın kenarını sildi.

meanings.en: to tear something quickly and forcefully
meanings.exampleEn: He ripped the letter into pieces.
meanings.exampleTr: Mektubu parçalara ayırarak yırttı.

meanings.exampleEn: Investing all your money in one stock is risky.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm paranızı tek bir hisse senedine yatırmak risklidir.

meanings.en: a formal religious or social ceremony
meanings.exampleEn: The wedding followed an ancient rite.
meanings.exampleTr: Düğün eski bir ayine göre yapıldı.

meanings.en: a set of actions performed regularly in a fixed way
meanings.exampleEn: Drinking tea in the morning is a daily ritual for her.
meanings.exampleTr: Sabahları çay içmek onun için günlük bir ritüeldir.

meanings.en: a person or group competing against another
meanings.exampleEn: The two companies have been rivals for years.
meanings.exampleTr: İki şirket yıllardır rakip durumda.

meanings.en: an act of wandering over a wide area
meanings.exampleEn: They went for a roam through the old town.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski şehirde bir dolaşmaya çıktılar.

meanings.en: to make a loud, deep sound
meanings.exampleEn: The lion began to roar in the distance.
meanings.exampleTr: Aslan uzakta kükremeye başladı.

meanings.en: cooked by dry heat in an oven or over a fire
meanings.exampleEn: We had roast chicken for dinner.
meanings.exampleTr: Akşam yemeğinde fırınlanmış tavuk yedik.

meanings.en: a vehicle or device propelled by burning fuel, used in space travel
meanings.exampleEn: The rocket was launched into space successfully.
meanings.exampleTr: Roket başarıyla uzaya fırlatıldı.

meanings.en: full of rocks or made of rock
meanings.exampleEn: The path to the beach was steep and rocky.
meanings.exampleTr: Plaja giden yol dik ve kayalıktı.

meanings.en: a person you share a room or home with
meanings.exampleEn: My roommate and I cook dinner together every evening.
meanings.exampleTr: Oda arkadaşım ve ben her akşam birlikte yemek yapıyoruz.

meanings.en: pink in color, or promising and hopeful
meanings.exampleEn: The future looked rosy after the good news.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi haberlerden sonra gelecek parlak görünüyordu.

meanings.en: a way or path taken to get from one place to another
meanings.exampleEn: We took a different route to avoid the traffic.
meanings.exampleTr: Trafikten kaçınmak için farklı bir güzergah izledik.

meanings.en: members of a royal family, or money paid to an author or artist
meanings.exampleEn: The crowd cheered as the royalty passed by.
meanings.exampleTr: Kraliyet ailesi geçerken kalabalık tezahürat yaptı.

meanings.en: to move your hand or an object back and forth on a surface with pressure
meanings.exampleEn: She rubbed her hands together to keep warm.
meanings.exampleTr: Isınmak için ellerini birbirine ovuşturdu.

meanings.en: broken stones or bricks from a destroyed building
meanings.exampleEn: Rescuers searched through the rubble for survivors.
meanings.exampleTr: Kurtarma ekipleri molozların arasında hayatta kalanları aradı.

meanings.en: a thick piece of fabric used to cover part of a floor
meanings.exampleEn: A colorful rug lay in front of the fireplace.
meanings.exampleTr: Şöminenin önünde renkli bir kilim seriliydi.

meanings.en: causing severe damage or financial loss
meanings.exampleEn: The war had a ruinous effect on the economy.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaşın ekonomi üzerinde yıkıcı bir etkisi oldu.

meanings.en: relating to the countryside rather than the city
meanings.exampleEn: They moved to a quiet rural area to raise their children.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklarını büyütmek için sakin bir kırsal bölgeye taşındılar.

meanings.en: the busy time when many people are traveling to or from work
meanings.exampleEn: Traffic is terrible during the morning rush hour.
meanings.exampleTr: Sabah yoğun saatlerinde trafik berbat oluyor.

meanings.en: covered with rust, or out of practice
meanings.exampleEn: The old gate was covered in rusty metal.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski kapı paslı metalle kaplıydı.

meanings.en: to dismiss someone from their job
meanings.exampleEn: The manager threatened to sack him for being late again.
meanings.exampleTr: Müdür tekrar geç kaldığı için onu işten kovmakla tehdit etti.

meanings.en: a downward bend or droop in the middle of something
meanings.exampleEn: There was a noticeable sag in the old mattress.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski yatağın ortasında belirgin bir çökme vardı.

meanings.en: a very wise person, or a herb used in cooking
meanings.exampleEn: The old sage gave the young man valuable advice.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı bilge, genç adama değerli öğütler verdi.

meanings.en: to travel on water in a boat or ship
meanings.exampleEn: They will sail across the ocean next summer.
meanings.exampleTr: Gelecek yaz okyanusu yelkenle geçecekler.

meanings.en: the skill of persuading people to buy things
meanings.exampleEn: His excellent salesmanship doubled the company's profits.
meanings.exampleTr: Mükemmel satış becerisi şirketin kârını ikiye katladı.

meanings.en: a person whose job is to sell goods or services
meanings.exampleEn: The salesperson helped me find the right laptop.
meanings.exampleTr: Satış görevlisi doğru dizüstü bilgisayarı bulmama yardım etti.

meanings.en: a woman whose job is to sell goods or services
meanings.exampleEn: The saleswoman showed us several dresses.
meanings.exampleTr: Kadın satış görevlisi bize birkaç elbise gösterdi.

meanings.en: a shop where hair or beauty treatments are given
meanings.exampleEn: She went to the salon to have her hair cut.
meanings.exampleTr: Saçını kestirmek için kuaföre gitti.

meanings.en: a spicy sauce, or a lively Latin American dance
meanings.exampleEn: We dipped the chips in spicy salsa.
meanings.exampleTr: Cipsleri acılı salsa sosuna batırdık.
